mongol-empire: At its height, the largest land empire in history, stretching from Korea to Hungary.
atlantic-slave-trade: Roughly 12.5 million Africans are forcibly shipped across the Atlantic to the Americas.
seven-years-war: Fought on five continents; Britain takes Canada from France and becomes the leading colonial power.
heiligenstadt-testament: In a letter to his brothers, Beethoven admits he is going deaf and that he considered suicide.
einstein-wins-the-nobel-prize: The 1921 physics prize, announced a year late, is awarded for the photoelectric effect, not relativity.
einsteins-letter-to-roosevelt: Einstein signs a letter warning that Germany might build an atomic bomb, which helps start the US nuclear programme.
february-strike: Amsterdam workers strike against the persecution of the Jews — the first mass protest against the Nazis in occupied Europe.
global-financial-crisis: Lehman Brothers collapses, triggering the worst financial crisis since the Great Depression.
